2.264.11
MapViewport.MapSize
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapViewport.MapSize element specifies the size of a MapViewport element. The
MapViewport.MapSize element is optional. If this element is not present, the map viewport size
MUST be automatically calculated. This element is of type MapSize.
Following is the parent element of the MapViewport.MapSize element.
Parent elements
MapViewport
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapViewport.MapSize element.
 <xsd:element name="MapSize" type="MapSizeType" minOccurs="0" />
